welcome.title: Welcome to Ten10
welcome.description: Ten10 tracks income, expenses, and donations — and calculates how much ma'aser (tithe) you still need to give. We'll look at Home and add your first transaction.
welcome.skip: I'll look around on my own

tour.homeIntroDescription: Three cards show income, expenses, and donations for the period you pick. The «Ma'aser balance» card tracks what you still owe across all time. We'll meet them, then add a transaction.
tour.dateRangeDescription: «From start of month», «From start of year», «All time», or a custom range. This changes the income, expense, and donation cards — not the ma'aser balance.
tour.titheBalanceDescription: How much ma'aser is still due — from all transactions, not just this month. Income adds 10% to the obligation; a donation reduces it. A minus means you already gave more than required — you have a credit.
tour.openingBalanceDescription: Already have a balance from a notebook or spreadsheet? The + on this card sets that starting point once. Ten10 continues from there — it is not a regular transaction.
tour.cardQuickAddDescription: The + on Income, Expenses, or Donations opens the form with that type already selected.
tour.continueToFormDescription: Next we'll open the form. First the everyday fields, then the options that decide how the transaction counts toward ma'aser.
tour.formIntroDescription: Every transaction is recorded here. Type, amount, date, and description are enough to save. The options below decide whether it counts toward ma'aser — and how.
tour.formImportDescription: Many rows in Excel or from the bank? Import a CSV or Excel file here in one go. Open it now or later — nothing is saved until you approve.
tour.formBasicsDescription: Choose the type — income, expense, or donation — enter the amount in any currency, a date, and a short description. Category helps you sort later.
tour.flagsDescription:
The buttons change with the transaction type:

  • Income — «Exempt from Ma'aser» skips the calculation. «Calculate Chomesh» takes 20% instead of 10%.
  • Expense — «Recognized Expense» reduces the obligation by 10% of the amount (or 20% for chomesh). A regular expense does not affect ma'aser.
  • Donation — a regular donation reduces the balance. «Not from ma'aser» is recorded without reducing the obligation.
tour.recurringDescription: This saves a standing order without creating a transaction now. Ten10 will create it automatically on the day you chose, at the frequency you pick — monthly by default.
tour.liveBalanceTitle: The balance updates after you save
tour.liveBalanceDescription: After you save, the summary cards on the side update — including the ma'aser balance. Nothing changes until you save.

success.title: Your first transaction is saved
success.description: On Home, below the cards, a «Monthly Summary» chart shows the trend. «Contact» opens a message to a rabbi or to the Ten10 team.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.description: Two short steps to see Ten10 at work.

pageTour.ariaLabel: Start a tour of this page

importTour.introDescription: Import many transactions from a CSV or Excel file. The flow has four stages: prepare, upload, map columns, and review. Only the rows you approve at the end are added to the table.
importTour.stepsDescription: Prepare, upload, map columns, then review. In review you confirm with «Import Now». You can go back at any stage. Nothing is saved before that confirmation.
importTour.checklistDescription: The file is parsed in the browser and nothing is saved until you approve. Date and amount are required. A Ten10 template is optional if your file has clear headers.
importTour.templateDescription: Download the Ten10 template to skip most column mapping. You can also upload your own file with clear headers.
importTour.uploadDescription: Drop a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file here, or click to choose one. .xls and PDF are not supported. After the file is read, you map the columns.
importTour.mappingDescription: Next you match each column in the file to a Ten10 field. Date and amount are required. The Ten10 template fills most of this in for you.
importTour.reviewDescription: You see a preview, fix errors, and choose what to import. Possible duplicates are flagged first.
importTour.approveDescription: Only after «Import Now» are the transactions added to the table. Until then you can go back, fix rows, or cancel — nothing is saved.
